credits.text: Deborah Namugosa, Beatrice Nabune, Alison Tukei, Rose Sabano
credits.art: Rob Owen, Wiehan de Jager, Amir Bachir António Necas

p: Let me tell you my story. I start as a small spark.
I run wild when the wind carries me.
We are good friends, you and I.
I am part of your family.
But be careful when you invite me to your home. I don't like to be left alone.
